info.title: Jobseeker Copilot - LLM Gateway API
info.description:
Single integration point between Jobseeker Copilot and OpenAI.

This gateway:
- Accepts a fully built prompt
- Sends it to OpenAI
- Returns generated content

This gateway does NOT:
- Build prompts
- Know about CVs, cover letters, jobs, benefits, or UC reports
- Make decisions based on taskType

tags.name: LLM Generation
tags.description: Endpoints for generating content via OpenAI

post.description:
Accepts a fully built prompt and sends it to OpenAI for generation.

The gateway does NOT build prompts, nor does it know about CVs, cover letters,
jobs, benefits, or UC reports. The taskType field is informational only.

The response may contain JSON text returned by OpenAI.

504.description: OpenAI did not respond in time

400.description: Validation error - missing or invalid fields

details: prompt: prompt is required and cannot be empty

401.description: OpenAI authentication failure - invalid API key

503.description: OpenAI server error or service unavailable

taskType.description: Informational field indicating the type of task. The gateway does not make decisions based on this value.

prompt.description: The fully assembled prompt to send to OpenAI. The gateway does not modify or build prompts.
prompt.example: Generate a CV using the following information...

temperature.description: Controls randomness of the output. Higher values produce more random results.

maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens in the generated response.

GenerateRequest.description: Request to generate content via OpenAI

provider.description: The LLM provider that generated the response

response.description: The generated content returned by the LLM. May contain JSON text returned by OpenAI.

GenerateResponse.description: Response containing generated content from the LLM provider

LlmUsage.description: Token usage reported by the LLM provider
